question: When was the taming ofthe shrew first performed?
text:
The earliest **possible** performance of Shakespeare’s *The Taming of the Shrew* was on **June 11, 1594**, at Newington Butts Theatre. The diary that records it calls the play *The Taming of a Shrew*, so it’s unclear whether it was Shakespeare’s version. ([shaxdoc.titania.folger.edu](https://shaxdoc.titania.folger.edu/node/553?utm_source=openai))

The earliest **confirmed** performance of Shakespeare’s version was on **November 26, 1633**, at St. James’s Palace before King Charles I and Queen Henrietta Maria. ([cambridge.org](https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/abs/taming-of-the-shrew/stagehistory/D20C8F841FC199D1934CCF2059EFA63F?utm_source=openai))
